purpose: Pankeki full product feature walkthrough; design concepts, not implemented screenshots

prompts.prompt:
Create a single realistic, production-quality Pankeki desktop app design screen, 1440 x 1024 viewport. This belongs to a coherent SEVEN-screen feature walkthrough, not alternative concepts. Show only the specified screen at full readable size. App content only, no browser/device frame, no collage, no marketing poster, no explanatory arrows. Date anchor 2026-10-20 Asia/Seoul; do not invent old dates or clocks.

Pankeki is a Korean original-character creation studio: settings/image generation -> compare -> mask inpainting -> reusable part editing -> expression/motion -> save/export. Preserve the SAME design system across all screens. Existing small pancake brand, white panels #FFFFFF, light-gray background #F4F5F6, graphite text #25282B, readable secondary #626A73, fine dividers #E2E5E8, interaction blue #4169B1. Korean Pretendard-like sans, control labels 14px, secondary at least 12px, compact sensible 32-36px controls, 4-6px radii. Use aligned rows/dividers and purposeful whitespace. No giant welcome heading, glowing gradients, dashboard metrics, decorative blobs, AI sparkles, card nesting, excessive pills or irrelevant menus. Serious creative tool. Main artwork is the largest relevant visual surface, with believable editing/selection states.

References: first attached image is the current real Pankeki screenshot; preserve its recognizable small pancake logo and bearded desert alchemist character (brown hat, blue-gray cloak, leather straps, desert rocks). Second attached image is a proposed Pankeki docked expression editor; use its brighter precise editor style consistently, without copying duplicated save buttons. Reuse this SAME character as the work asset throughout, no generic replacement avatar. Candidate alternatives, glove crops, transparent parts, eye/mouth closeups and expression thumbnails must clearly belong to this same character.

All new renders are DESIGN CONCEPTS, not proof of running features. A discreet bottom line must say "Pankeki · 전체 화면 설계안". Show the readiness statement specified for each screen as clear supporting text, never imply all features work. Existing generation/comparison/mask editing/project data code exists but runtime needs restoration; named parts, rigging, mesh/keyforms/motion, enhanced project format and some exports are planned. Chat model is currently unconnected, never invent AI replies or fake completed generation logs.

Editing screens have compact top project identity "사막의 연금술사", navigation "디자인", "부위", "표정·동작", "출력", with only the relevant stage active, small undo/redo and ordinary save access. Do not duplicate the primary action. No made-up PSD/moc3/MP4 support. Different functions are reached via steps/tabs/context; do not cram every tool into one frame. Render Korean accurately and legibly. Each final screen should be a coherent usable product view, not a diagram.
SCREEN: 프로젝트 홈. This whole home screen is a proposed feature. Show a coherent full desktop project home with pancake + Pankeki at upper left, simple left sidebar "프로젝트", "최근 작업", "도움말" and a small settings link. Main heading "프로젝트" is modest 24px. Across the top of the main area, two clear entry points "새 캐릭터 생성" (primary blue) and "내 이미지로 시작" (secondary). A separate modest text action "프로젝트 불러오기" is available. Below, "최근 프로젝트" with two large clean project previews of the same alchemist artwork: "사막의 연금술사" and "연금술사 표정 연구". A project preview shows its art and a restrained line "디자인 · 부위 · 표정" as contents, not fake completion stats. Show no dates, user identity, online collaborators, usage counters or market analytics. Below recent projects, a slim flat guidance strip "설정으로 만들거나, 가지고 있는 그림에서 이어서 작업하세요." Good whitespace, not empty marketing space. This home should make it clear that IMAGE GENERATION and IMPORT are both ways into the app. Tiny readiness text at bottom "프로젝트 홈은 신규 화면 구성안입니다." No four-step editor nav in home; that appears only inside a project. The home should feel intentional and calm, not an admin dashboard.
